units.source_text: 每次矿车上装好了土，矿车两个小工就会站到矿车上。

en.t: Each time the mine cart had been loaded with earth, the two young workers would climb onto it.

units.source_text: 矿车顺着山势走下坡路，无需人力就能飞跑起来。

en.t: The mine cart would follow the slope of the mountain downhill and go racing off without anyone pushing it.

units.source_text: 矿车晃动着车的底座往前走，工人们外衣的下摆随风飞扬，狭长的路轨蜿蜒向前——良平望着这副情景，心里很想去当个土方工人。

en.t: The mine cart rattled forward, its base shaking, while the hems of the workers' jackets fluttered in the wind and the long narrow track wound on ahead. Watching the scene, Ryohei felt a strong desire to become an earthwork laborer himself.

units.source_text: 他心里很想和那些工人一起坐一次矿车，哪怕就一回呢。

en.t: He badly wanted to ride in the mine cart with those workers, even if only once.

units.source_text: 矿车开到村边的平地上，就自然地停在那里了。

en.t: When the mine cart reached the flat ground at the edge of the village, it came to a stop there on its own.

units.source_text: 同时，工人们很轻巧地从矿车上跳下来，片刻功夫，就把车上里的土全部倾倒在轨道的尽头处了。

en.t: At the same time, the workers nimbly jumped down from the cart, and in no time they had dumped all the earth from it at the end of the track.

units.source_text: 接着，工人们便一步步推着矿车，沿着来的时候的路爬坡上山。

en.t: Then the workers pushed the mine cart step by step, climbing back up the slope along the way they had come.

units.source_text: 这个时候良平心想，就算乘不了矿车，只要能推推它也是很好的呀。

en.t: At that moment Ryohei thought that even if he could not ride in the mine cart, it would still be wonderful just to push it a little.
